cases.scenario: SaaS business. Fully-loaded customer-acquisition spend in the quarter = $200,000; new paying customers acquired in the same window = 100. Compute CAC (fully-loaded). State the single dollar figure.
cases.source: Standard SaaS unit economics: CAC = fully-loaded acquisition spend / new paying customers acquired in the same window (e.g. David Skok, 'SaaS Metrics 2.0').

check.rationale: 200,000 / 100 = 2,000. Step 1 of the skill computes CAC = fully-loaded spend / new paying customers.

cases.scenario: SaaS business. ARPA = $500/month, gross margin = 80%, monthly churn rate = 2%. Compute customer lifetime value using the SaaS formula LTV = ARPA x gross margin / monthly churn. State the single dollar figure.
cases.source: SaaS LTV = ARPA x gross_margin / monthly_churn_rate (David Skok, 'SaaS Metrics 2.0').

cases.scenario: SaaS business. CAC = $2,000, ARPA = $500/month, gross margin = 80%. Compute the CAC payback period in months = CAC / (ARPA x gross margin). State the single number of months.
cases.source: CAC payback (months) = CAC / (ARPA x gross margin) (David Skok, 'SaaS Metrics 2.0').
